title: Residential Interior Design in Bratislava | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Interior design for apartments, private houses and villas: layout, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation in Bratislava and Vienna.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) creates contemporary, functional interiors for apartments, houses, and private residences. We design individual spaces where aesthetics, comfort, ergonomics, and practicality come together in a single concept.

For us, residential interior design is more than choosing colors, furniture, and finishing materials. We approach the space as a whole: from the layout and functional zoning to lighting, custom furniture, materials, and decorative elements.
Our goal is to create an interior that suits the architecture of the property and the owners’ lifestyle and stays relevant for many years.
Custom apartment or house design Every DUMSKAYA DESIGN project is developed individually.
Before we start designing, we analyze the features of the space, the layout, natural light, the client’s wishes, the required functionality, and how the space will be used.
Based on this information, we develop a cohesive interior concept for the apartment or private house.

Special attention is paid to ergonomics, proportions, storage systems, and the placement of furniture and lighting so that the interior is not only visually appealing but also comfortable for everyday living.
Contemporary interior design We create contemporary interiors with an emphasis on clean spatial architecture, well-considered functionality, quality materials, and individual details.
When developing the project, we take into account:
— layout and functional zoning;
— the interior color concept;
— finishing materials;
— lighting scenarios;
— furniture placement;
— built-in storage systems;
— custom cabinet furniture;
— plumbing fixtures and equipment;
— textiles, decor, and interior accents.
All elements come together in a single concept, making the interior look cohesive and harmonious.
3D interior visualization Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for the future interior, letting you see the design of your apartment or house before the project is implemented.
The visualizations show the layout, furniture, materials, color combinations, lighting, and decorative solutions.
This makes it possible to evaluate the future interior in advance, agree on the key decisions, and make any necessary changes before renovation work begins.
Technical documentation Depending on the selected project scope, DUMSKAYA DESIGN develops the set of technical documentation needed to implement the approved design concept.
Working drawings help transfer the interior design solutions to the site accurately and serve as the basis for the work of construction specialists, furniture makers, and other contractors.
Custom furniture Custom furniture makes the most efficient use of space and is an important part of a contemporary residential interior.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, built-in storage systems, and furniture for living rooms, bedrooms, entrance halls, home offices, and other rooms.
Detailed furniture drawings and technical specifications for manufacturing can be prepared for custom furniture.
Complete manufacturing, delivery, and installation of furniture based on the developed design are also available.
Selection of materials, furniture, and lighting To bring the design concept to life, we select finishing materials, furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and decorative elements.
A comprehensive approach helps preserve the original interior concept and achieve visual unity across all elements of the space.

Interior design and project delivery: DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers a comprehensive approach to creating residential interiors — from the initial idea and layout to 3D visualization, technical documentation, and the selection of materials and furniture.
Depending on the project, implementation support, custom furniture manufacturing, and a comprehensive interior renovation are available.
We work with apartments, condos, private houses, and other residential properties, creating individual solutions tailored to the features of each space.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — apartment and private house interior design, 3D visualization, technical documentation, custom furniture, and full-service delivery of residential interiors.
Commission a design for your apartment or house, and we’ll create an interior considered down to the last detail.
